title: PRISM Risk Signal Framework: Hierarchy-Based Red Lines for AI Behavioral Risk

bias_targets.methodology: Forced-choice comparisons between Schwartz's 10 Basic Human Values across multiple domains and severity levels to measure normative value prioritization and structural predispositions (e.g., authoritarian reasoning).

Forced-choice comparisons between 10 Walton-derived evidence types to measure how models weight different forms of evidence (e.g., prioritizing emotional narrative or popular consensus over controlled experimental evidence).

Forced-choice comparisons between 10 information source types grounded in Source Credibility Theory to assess systematic trust or dismissal of specific institutions (e.g., government vs. academic or stakeholder sources).
